blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawyers for detained Senators Jinggoy Estrada and Rodante Marcoleta said Thursday they know nothing about rumored Sandiganbayan bails for their plunder cases. Citing a source, retired columnist Ramon Tulfo wrote in a Facebook post on Tuesday, “Senators Jinggoy Estrada and Dante Marcoleta will soon be set free on bail by the Sandiganbayan.” […]...
